query: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(takedowns), 0) FROM takedown_counts WHERE caller_id = ?) AS "initiated!: i64", (SELECT coalesce(sum(takedowns + counters), 0) FROM takedown_counts WHERE target_id = ?) AS "received!: i64", ((SELECT coalesce(sum(counters), 0) FROM takedown_counts WHERE caller_id = ?) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(parries), 0) FROM parry_counts WHERE user_id = ?)) AS "countered!: i64"
